name: codex-threadctl
description: Codex skill for discovering, inspecting, and controlling app-server-backed threads.

interface.shortDescription: Discover, inspect, and control app-server-backed Codex threads.
interface.longDescription: Codex Threadctl provides guidance for discovering persisted threads, inspecting activity and context, retrieving messages, starting or steering input, resuming stored threads, and interrupting exact turns.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $codex-threadctl to discover, inspect, or immediately control a Codex thread.
